name: Franconia Ridge Loop
highlights: Peak fall foliage vistas across Pemigewasset Wilderness; above tree-line ridge walking.

waypoints.name: Cloudland Falls
waypoints.desc: 80-ft horsetail waterfall. Listen for the roar before the steep climb.

waypoints.name: Little Haystack Mountain
waypoints.desc: Treeline exit. Intense western winds and panoramic autumn foliage.

waypoints.name: Mount Lafayette Summit
waypoints.desc: Highest point (5,260 ft). Stone foundation of 1850s summit house.

waypoints.name: Greenleaf Hut
waypoints.desc: AMC mountain hut on Eagle Lake.

name: Alum Cave Trail to Mount LeConte
highlights: Rhododendron tunnels, Arch Rock passage, massive concaved Alum Cave Bluffs, red spruce forest.

waypoints.name: Arch Rock
waypoints.desc: Natural slate stone tunnel with stone staircase.

waypoints.name: Inspiration Point
waypoints.desc: Sweeping vista of Little Duck Hawk Ridge.

name: Mist Trail to Nevada Fall
highlights: Vernal Fall spray, emerald pools, iconic granite monoliths, Merced River canyon.

waypoints.name: Vernal Fall Footbridge
waypoints.desc: First view of the falls and drinking water refill.

waypoints.name: Top of Vernal Fall
waypoints.desc: Massive sheer granite apron overlooking the valley.

name: Angel's Landing Trail
highlights: Walter's Wiggles 21 switchbacks, sheer 1,000-ft drops, spectacular 360-degree canyon views.

waypoints.name: The Spine / Angel's Landing
waypoints.desc: Narrow fin of sandstone with anchor chains.

name: Lac Blanc Trail
highlights: Mirror reflections of Mont Blanc massif, ibex and chamois grazing, alpine lakes at 2,352m.

waypoints.name: Lac de la Flégère
waypoints.desc: Gentle alpine tarn surrounded by larches.

waypoints.name: Ladders Section
waypoints.desc: Bolted metal ladders crossing granite step.

waypoints.name: Lac Blanc Refuge
waypoints.desc: High alpine refuge (2,352m) directly opposite Mer de Glace.
